decisions.reason: The safety shoe line moved from a general mention to its own page by 2024, which signals growing commercial relevance in the firm's core market.
The comfort insole appears to remain a useful accessory offer for the work-shoe range, even if its website visibility stayed modest.
The supportive insole has limited standalone visibility and is at risk of being rationalised because it overlaps with the firm's broader and more prominent insole offerings.
The ergonomic safety shoe series had its own page in both 2023 and 2024, indicating a stable strategic position in a core product category.
Firefighter and rescue boots gained their own page by 2024, suggesting the firm sees enough demand in this specialist segment to continue.
The moulded insole stayed on the home page and was supported by a concrete customer-use case, which points to strong market traction and strategic importance.
